info.title: roslynaut
info.description: An MCP server that exposes Roslyn and MSBuild to agents: navigation, analysis, refactoring, builds and tests, IL/JIT disassembly, decompilation, process inspection and debugging of C# projects.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: An MCP server that exposes Roslyn and MSBuild to agents.

options.name: --protocol
options.description: The transport that carries MCP. [default: stdio]

options.name: --disable-tools
options.description: Leave these tools out, also when --enable-tools names them.

options.name: --no-instructions
options.description: Leave out the server instructions, which tell agents which tool to use for what.

options.name: --tool-descriptions
options.description: The tools' descriptions in the tools' schemas: full, short (the first sentence), caveman (terse, keeping identifiers and keywords) or none, for less of agents' context; explain_tool gives them in full. [default: full]

options.name: --field-descriptions
options.description: The parameters' descriptions in the tools' schemas: full, short (the first sentence), caveman (terse, keeping identifiers and keywords) or none, for less of agents' context; explain_tool gives them in full. [default: full]

options.name: --install
options.description: Register the server with this agent for all projects, and exit. Claude Code also gets a hook, and OpenCode a plugin, that suggests its tools when the agent reads or greps C# files.

options.name: --no-hooks
options.description: With --install, register the server alone: Claude Code gets no hooks and OpenCode no plugin, and those of an earlier installation are removed.

options.name: --uninstall
options.description: Remove the server and its hook or plugin from this agent, as before uninstalling the tool, and exit.
